Bento template tests are pure data-transformation functions — no DI/DB/HTTP, no mocking needed. Each template needs 8-13 tests covering defaultTheme, toSlides counts, element types, data propagation, and edge cases (empty arrays, falsy values, many items).

null coalescing (??) in test data builders makes passing null impossible — the builder always returns the default. For testing falsy behavior, use empty string or undefined.
